_meta.note: Source catalog. Keys marked in docs/design/i18n.md as new were added to demonstrate plurals and number formatting.

messages.settings.title: Settings
messages.settings.notice.plaintext: Settings are kept in this browser in plain text, including RPC URLs. Do not put a URL there that contains a secret you would not store in plain text. No key is ever stored.
messages.settings.rpc.hint: Only https:// and wss:// are accepted, with no username or password. The chain id is verified when the endpoint is used. No default RPC is built in.
messages.settings.rpc.connected: Connected. The endpoint reports the expected chain id.
messages.settings.rpc.failed: Failed: the endpoint is unreachable or reports a different chain.
messages.settings.rpc.secondary.label: {chain} second RPC URL (optional)
messages.settings.rpc.secondary.hint: A different provider. Scans compare it with the main RPC and withhold the checkpoint when they disagree.
messages.settings.relayer.label: Relayer URL (optional)
messages.settings.relayer.hint: https only. The relayer sees the one-time address, destination, token, amount and timing of each sweep it handles.
messages.settings.delay.range: Each payment is delayed between {min, number} and {max, number} seconds.
messages.settings.lock.label: Lock local tags after idle minutes
messages.settings.lock.hint: Keys stay in memory until you wipe them or close the tab.
messages.settings.lock.summary: Locks after {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} without activity.
messages.settings.theme.label: Theme
messages.settings.autoclear.label: Remove the invoice from the address bar after reading it
messages.settings.pins.label: Pinned seller signing keys (one per line)
messages.settings.pins.hint: Only keys you pin are described as pinned. Get them from the seller over a channel you trust.
messages.settings.pins.count: {count, plural, =0 {No pinned signer keys} one {# pinned signer key} other {# pinned signer keys}}
messages.settings.storageUnavailable: Browser storage is unavailable, so these settings apply to this tab only.
messages.settings.error.pins: Pinned signer keys must be 66 hexadecimal characters starting with 02 or 03, one per line.
messages.settings.error.lock: Lock timeout must be 1 to 240 minutes.
messages.i18n.picker.label: Language
messages.i18n.picker.noCatalog: not translated yet, English is shown
messages.i18n.picker.hint: Translations marked machine-translated have not been reviewed by a native speaker. Check amounts, addresses and fees against your wallet.
messages.i18n.loadFailed: The selected language could not be loaded. English is shown instead.
messages.settings.exchange.title: Transfer nonsecret preferences
messages.settings.exchange.description: Share only saved delay, lock, theme and address-bar preferences. URLs, credentials, pinned signer trust and private keys are excluded. Review an import before applying it.
messages.btc.title: Bitcoin silent payments (test networks)
messages.btc.warning.title: Proof of concept, test networks only
messages.btc.warning.body: Unaudited. Mainnet is disabled. Use only coins that have no value (testnet4, signet or a local regtest node). Keys are held in memory and are never saved; write down the seed if you want to keep the wallet.
messages.btc.network.label: Network
messages.btc.server.label: Esplora server URL
messages.btc.server.hint: Any Esplora-compatible REST server you trust for this network (https, or http to localhost for regtest). It sees every block height you scan, each matching output outpoint you check for spent status, and any transaction you broadcast. It cannot see your keys.
messages.btc.wallet.importHint: 64 hex characters (32 bytes) from a wallet created here. Test coins only.
messages.btc.payment.heading: Payment instructions
messages.btc.payment.step1: Open a wallet that supports BIP-352 silent payments on {network}.
messages.btc.payment.step2: Send to the address above, or scan the QR code or open this link:
messages.btc.payment.step3: Wait for one confirmation, then use "Scan" below starting a few blocks before the payment.
messages.btc.payment.caption: Silent payment request ({network})
messages.btc.seed.title: Backup seed (shown once)
messages.btc.seed.warning: Anyone with this seed controls the wallet. It is not stored anywhere.
messages.btc.scan.heightHint: Scans at most {max} blocks per run up to the server tip. Whole blocks are downloaded and checked on this device.
messages.btc.scan.details: What the scan checks, and what it does not
messages.btc.scan.checked: Checked on this device for every block:
messages.btc.scan.firstHeightRequired: Enter the first block height to scan.
messages.btc.scan.noneFound: No unspent payments found in this range.
messages.btc.scan.singleProvider: Output and spent status were checked with the configured Esplora provider. This is a single-provider check, not independent verification. Select and review each exact transaction output below.
messages.btc.scan.duplicateKey: Duplicate output key; verify this exact outpoint
messages.btc.sweep.destinationHint: A {network} address or silent payment address (tsp1...). Check it carefully: a sent transaction cannot be reversed.
messages.btc.sweep.invalidQr: The Bitcoin payment QR is not valid.
messages.btc.sweep.feeHint: Chosen by you; this app has no fee oracle. Transactions signal RBF (BIP-125).
messages.btc.review.heading: Review before signing
messages.btc.review.silentKeyHint: The actual output key of a silent payment is derived when signing, so it is not shown here.
messages.btc.review.approve: I checked the destination address, the amount and the fee.
messages.btc.signed.heading: Signed transaction
messages.btc.signed.notSent: Not sent yet. Broadcasting sends it to the server above.

messages.policy.title: Policy accounts (experimental)
messages.policy.warning.title: Experimental and unaudited
messages.policy.intro: A policy meta-address (scheme 0x47500002) makes every payment land in a small contract account that can only pay out to your chosen destination, after a delay and within per-token limits. A stolen key is delayed, not stopped: watch the account and cancel what you did not sign.
messages.policy.error.noRpc: Configure an RPC for this network in Settings first.
messages.policy.wallet.heading: Wallet
messages.policy.network.heading: Network and contracts
messages.policy.network.label: Test network
messages.policy.network.notPinned: No policy deployment is pinned for any network. Enter a factory and router you deployed yourself; the app reads the implementation, fee recipient and announcer back from the chain.
messages.policy.create.heading: Create a policy meta-address
messages.policy.create.needSession: Load or generate seller keys first (Seller keys).
messages.policy.create.otherKeys: Record verified, but it belongs to other seller keys than the ones loaded now. Scanning will not find its payments.
messages.policy.create.badDestinations: Enter one or more checksummed destination addresses.
messages.policy.create.notFound: No match among these destinations, the delay presets and the known limits roots. A policy with limits can only be restored from its record.
messages.policy.create.restored: Policy found and restored. Download the record now.
messages.policy.create.destinationLabel: Destination (the only address withdrawals can go to)
messages.policy.create.destinationHint: Use a wallet you control and keep. Changing it later takes twice the delay and can be cancelled by anyone holding your keys.
messages.policy.create.limitsHint: Leave empty for no limits. With limits, a token without a row can never be withdrawn. Amounts are base units; window in seconds; token "native" for the coin.
messages.policy.create.keepBody: Without the record (destination, delay and limits) the account cannot be deployed and nothing can be withdrawn. It holds no keys, but it links your destination to this meta-address: store it privately, next to your seller key backup.
messages.policy.create.lostBody: The policy hash in a meta-address can be matched against likely destinations and the delay presets, locally. Policies with limits need their record.
messages.policy.pay.heading: Pay a policy meta-address
messages.policy.pay.metaHint: Get it from the payee over a channel you trust: you cannot check the policy behind it.
messages.policy.pay.amountInvalid: Enter the amount as a whole number of base units.
messages.policy.pay.connectToSend: Connect a wallet on this network to send.
messages.policy.pay.keepHashes: Transactions your wallet sent (keep these; do not resend):
messages.policy.account.walletRequired: Connect a wallet on this network to relay the transaction (any account may relay).
messages.policy.account.tokenInvalid: The token must be "native" or a checksummed address.
messages.policy.account.partialHistory: Only part of the account history was read (request cap). Pending actions may be missing.
messages.policy.account.deployMismatch: The deployment would create another account. Nothing was sent.
messages.policy.account.amountInvalid: Enter an amount in base units.
messages.policy.account.label: Account
messages.policy.account.notDeployed: Not deployed yet. Deploying reveals the full policy (destination, delay, limits) on-chain.
messages.policy.receive.heading: Find and withdraw policy payments
messages.policy.receive.needSession: Load or generate seller keys first (Seller keys).
messages.policy.receive.needPolicy: Create or import a policy record first: the scanner matches payments by policy.
messages.policy.receive.result: {count} policy announcement(s) read, {fresh} new for your keys.
messages.policy.receive.capped: Stopped at a cap: scan again to continue.
